Choose the chapter that covers these goods. Options:

    contains 401211: Retreaded tyres; of a kind used on motor cars (including station wagons and racing cars)
    contains 401219: Retreaded tyres; other than of a kind used on motor cars (including station wagons and racing cars), buses and lorries and aircraft
    contains 401150: Rubber; new pneumatic tyres, of a kind used on bicycles
    contains 401120: Rubber; new pneumatic tyres, of a kind used on buses or lorries

data.reason: A new pneumatic passenger car tyre is covered by Chapter 40 (heading 4011, subheading 401110), not by Chapter 87, which covers vehicles and their parts but excludes rubber tyres.
